title: What will be the top US Netflix show this week?
description:
Netflix is expected to update its Top 10 TV shows list on top10.netflix.com on Tuesday, July 21, 2026, 3:00 PM ET, reflecting viewership from the previous week (Monday to Sunday).

This market will resolve based on which show this update ranks as the #1 US Netflix show.

The ranking is based on total views in the United States, as reported by Netflix for TV shows.

If the top10.netflix.com update does not occur by July 24, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders see no clear frontrunner this week as multiple Netflix titles cluster tightly between 42% and 50% implied probability, reflecting balanced competition across genres and release types. Weekly viewership rankings hinge on factors such as new-season debuts, returning prestige series, limited-event programming, and reality formats that can surge with social-media momentum or algorithmic promotion. Historical patterns show that chart-topping performance often shifts quickly based on streaming metrics, audience completion rates, and cross-platform buzz rather than long-term critical acclaim. With resolution tied to the next official Nielsen or internal Netflix update, any late-week spikes in engagement or platform pushes could tip the balance among the tightly bunched contenders.
